summary: Baseline reform revision. Latest change: bear respelling (verb -> behr, animal -> baer); Behring proper noun removed.
note: The euspell spelling-reform standard, versioned independently of the app versions. Increment on any change to the reformed spellings in the lexicon, then re-release the products that embed it (extension, Eupub, office add-ins). Apps embed this value to declare which spelling standard a build was compiled against.
